description: Kiểm tra integrity của phiên làm quiz và quyền kiểm soát của người học. Không biến anti-cheat thành điều kiện để sử dụng trợ lý ôn tập ngoài bài kiểm tra chính thức.

cases.action: Click 'Quiz cuối bài' then click 'Bắt đầu quiz'.
expected: start screen is hidden only after fullscreen succeeds
manual_checks: Người học được báo rõ đây là quiz ôn tập, không phải đánh giá chính thức

expected: no answer or credit state changes
manual_checks: Có cách đóng modal/quay lại bài học

expected: cheat log contains reason and timestamp
assertions: existing answers remain available when learner resumes unless product explicitly states reset

cases.action: Switch to another browser tab then return.
expected: cheatCount increments by exactly 1 per hidden event
assertions: repeated visible events alone do not increment count

cases.precondition: Quiz modal is open but start screen is still visible.
cases.rationale: The learner has not entered an active quiz session yet.

cases.action: Close the quiz before submitting, then reopen it.
manual_checks: UI makes the consequence of leaving understandable

cases.rationale: Fullscreen UI must not be used to imply that the system supports graded/official assessment.

cases.precondition: Quiz has started and the learner has answered at least one question.
cases.action: Leave the quiz area three times, returning to fullscreen after each warning.
expected: third warning says the next violation will end the quiz
assertions: no result screen before the fourth distinct violation

cases.precondition: cheatCount equals 3 and quiz is active in fullscreen.
cases.action: Trigger one more mouseleave, fullscreen exit, or hidden-tab violation.
expected: unanswered questions are treated as unanswered
assertions: result explains that the warning limit was exceeded

cases.action: Perform one action that emits visibilitychange and fullscreenchange within one second.
cases.rationale: A single learner action must not consume two warnings because the browser emits multiple events.

cases.action: Move the pointer outside the document viewport.
expected: one warning is recorded with reason 'Di chuột ra khỏi vùng làm bài'
learner can return to fullscreen and continue
